contains: Once the fold drive is lit there is no switching it off.
The fold drive is already on.
You get out of the flight couch.
Hold

The Sparrow's hold, a steel room no wider than a corridor, ribbed with cargo netting. A suit locker stands bolted to the aft bulkhead, and a ladder climbs to the cockpit hatch at the forward end. The ramp slopes down to the dock.
Airlock
The deck plates here are scored where a thousand parcels have been dragged across them. Your boots fit the grooves.
The Sparrow settles with a thump you feel in your boots.
Airlock

A closet of a room in the Sparrow's port side, big enough for one carrier in a suit and not much else. The inner door stands open to the hold. The outer hatch is a slab of grey steel with a wheel at chest height, a pressure gauge beside it, and a placard: CHECK THE GAUGE. THEN THE WINDOW. THEN THE WHEEL.
Grey steel a hand's width thick
A brass-rimmed dial under scratched glass.
You open the outer hatch.
numbered 14 in paint
The outer hatch is already open.
Landing Pad

Pad 14 is a circle of old cement under a black sky, its number touched up by hand. Ceres curves away in every direction, close and grey, and a tram line runs north toward the lit dome of Piazzi Town. The Sparrow's open hatch is behind you.
You can see a pad master here.
A woman in a patched suit is already walking toward you from the tram.
Dolores Quint, pad master of 14
A single open car sits at the pad end with its brake set.
